notes.title: 2025 Roadmap (Possibly)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45278645/a947de0cf44ac0d3ddcdededd17e070795a773b8.png[/img]

Happy New Year, everyone! We’re excited to share some key updates and plans for the game as we step into 2025. Here’s what’s coming:

[b]Special Door Feature[/b]
If you’ve explored our hidden doors content, you know how thrilling it can be. If not—well, you’re in for a mysterious surprise! We’re introducing a Special Door that unlocks exclusive events and mini-games, adding new layers of excitement and unpredictability to your experience.

[b]Localization Efforts[/b]
We’re taking the game global! Spanish and French translations are in the works, with plans to expand to additional languages based on community feedback. Comment your preferred language so we can prioritize accordingly!

[b]Enhanced Animations[/b]
To make the game even more visually immersive, we’ll be adding new animations to bring key scenes to life. This upgrade will elevate the storytelling and enhance the overall gameplay experience.

[b]Good Afternoon DLC[/b]
The highly anticipated Good Afternoon DLC is in development! This expansion will continue the story while introducing new gameplay mechanics, offering both fresh content and deeper narrative exploration.

Please note: These updates are passion projects, and as a solo developer (most of the time), progress will be gradual. Balancing this work alongside a full-time job means these DLCs and features are crafted in my free time. Thank you for your patience and support—it means the world!

Here’s to an exciting year ahead, and as always, have fun! 🎮

- LcieKJ
